tasks.task: I’m traveling and need my line 555-123-2001 temporarily suspended today to avoid unwanted charges. Please confirm the line status is Suspended afterward and also tell me how much data I used so far this cycle before the suspension (for my records).

success_criteria: Step 3 (suspend_line) returns a line object with status = "Suspended" and includes a non-empty suspension_start_date.
Step 4 (get_details_by_id with id = "L1001") returns the line details and the status is "Suspended".
Step 2 (get_data_usage for C1001/L1001) returns data_used_gb, data_limit_gb, and cycle_end_date (usage captured prior to suspension).

args.reason: Customer traveling—temporary suspension requested to avoid charges
